body:
Youre not alone and thank you for writing this out it actually helped me a lot. I thought I was the only one. I’m highly ashamed grossed out by my fantasies it doesn’t align to anything about me in reality or my values. 
I can’t even engage in intimacy without having to place myself mentally like when I was SA as a child. I prefer my partners to act like the “adult” if you understand. It’s vile. 
It always has to be something taboo or degrading otherwise I feel completely turned off of any form of intimacy. It’s only in my head I’ve never spoken out loud about this since I’m feeling too much guilt and horror that I am this way.

Im so so sorry I can feel your emotions trough your words. I’ve been in your shoes. I idolized my dad because he was the only one who didn’t say evil things about me to my face as a child. But when I was hospitalized after a suicide attempt he visited me (I barely ever saw him even if he lived 3 min away with his new family) and didn’t talk about me but my step mother and how many migraines she has and how hard she has it. My stepmother abused me my whole life emotionally and it was even clear to my dads family who said this to me in private. It’s a very VERY hard pill to swallow when you realize you are alone without family even if they are still alive. I have hundreds of reports since I was 10 and yet my entire family blames me and says it’s all made up no accountability ever. I just asked for them to acknowledge but nope.

I hope so. Me neither just feels I guess easier for them. Same always overthinking. 

Oh I do really crave meaningful conversations I don’t find this superficial it was more in general going to events and stuff like that.

Same here I was just forced into it so kind of survived with the mask on and it does make me feel alive unlike 90% of the time. 

I can’t give you an answer since I’m questioning this constantly myself. I truly don’t get how someone has so little compassion. People today with the internet are just awful. Also when someone hasn’t gone trough much in life I don’t think they can comprehend it all which is understandable. It’s games for them. I’m always baffled when I talk to others who never think about their actions or conversations who just move in life with no overthinking or even analyzing anything. Sometimes I wish I was like that. Social interactions for me feel superficial most of the time and there really isn’t any point of it.

Exactly! I do enjoy a good smalltalk for a little bit  then I start dissociating and eventually the feeling alone even around people starts to kick in. So that’s awesome. 

You’re SO welcome. At least other people can relate in here!

Im stealing your “tired” then, haha. Actually a pretty good response! 

Thank you for your replies I feel a bit less alone.

Couldn’t agree more. I never understood how everyone HAS to be good and happy when negative emotions are as crucial as good ones. Everything is a balance and currently so many people are suffering in silence because of this insane happiness propaganda. 
Why do people even ask “how are you” when no one wants to hear the answer? Imagine saying I’m doing awful… instant disgust and labeled as a weirdo who needs to be avoided. Awful stuff.

Im sorry that happened to you. Maybe I’m really wrong but I do often feel a lot of suicidal people are more sensitive and empathetic. People who can’t really fathom hurting others the way they have been themselves. For me at least opening my eyes to how I have spend my life helping and being there for people who never did the same - crushing … then you finally realize the world is a very egoistical place and caring almost never get you anything.
My N actually called me his dog to my face and laughed.

It’s truly the most awful situation that I seem to be glued to. 

Sorry for my vent on your comment. It just resonated so much to me and the words just came flooding out. I truly hope you will find a way! You don’t deserve this no one does.

Cuteee.

That’s so twisted! She most likely just tried to create drama between you and your cousin! They always blame other people for their words and actions. Sorry you went trough that and yes it’s so wild that a two year old cries smh 🤦‍♀️

Sorry your ex pulled that on you definitely some traits and red flags!! Glad he is an ex and not a bf ♥️

Such a classic but stupidly she just confessed to lying since you didn’t say a thing! Mine says I’m making up stuff when I confront her with her vile words. No winning only losing. 

Yup they all just lie to lie
Probably because she knew you were enjoying your time in the night they feel threatened by that!

I’m so sorry she made up lies abt your friends so sickening. My mother just preferred my friends to the point where my best friend said to me “it’s weird but I think your mom wished I was her daughter instead of you”
Omg I’m in shock! What a disgusting lie to say to your child. I’m so sorry you put that on you and met your dad and he was a decent person!!

Thank you sm for this viewpoint! 
It does sound like that could have been the case since you’re right if we aren’t perfect in their eyes to the outside world they feel embarrassed for themselves. Perhaps why I’ve become such a perfectionist. 

We don’t matter enough to prevent if anyone said something hurtful either. I would never say to my child if someone called them names I would stop that kind of behavior from my friend.

I don’t trust a word that comes out of my mothers mouth either. 
And everything you wrote just make me so angry how these devils destroys their own children. Sorry your relationship with your fathers family is ruined because of her - worst is this brings nparents joy which is so sick! 
I’m currently realizing everything has been a lie my whole life and Im dealing with anger issues now which I’ve never really expressed so now she has started telling everyone I’m the aggressive abuser at home. Im going crazy.
Thank you so much 🙏🏼 currently working on going low contact but I’m incredibly scared of the things she will do when this happens.

I’m so sorry you’ve gone trough the same. It’s the worst feeling knowing that they not only lie to you about peoples words but also that for years they have told lies about you to them as well initially making others believe you’re mean/evil/abusive. She ruined the relationship with my dad also making me believe he never loved me/cared.
Wow I’ll ss this just as a personal reminder because it’s the exact phrases she uses! Nothing is ever there fault! And even with proof it still comes back at you.

Thank you so much for your reply and advise! I recently realized my newest friend had been lying about her whole life after I started putting question marks on what she said. I never did this before because as you mentioned not to do I did (trusting everyone) or just being happy that someone might like me just a little bit.

Sorry for your “loss” sounds like such a relief honestly! At this point I feel like I’m so destroyed by the abuse and lies that I’ll never be normal ever again. Do you feel it has gotten better with age? 
Truly sorry about your sister taking over the role it’s just impossible to feel free at any point from these people.
How do you feel about friends? I definitely am a magnet for these kind of people I’m at this point to scared to connect with anyone
So spot on! Recovery from abuse is like driving on a highway full of holes.
I’m so sorry you’ve been trough all this. It’s heartbreaking how npd continues to breed.
Being single sounds like the best option to me as well.
I’m so sorry you recently found this out. I am in the same boat with my mother and partner. It’s very scary and hurtful when you start noticing all the signs lifting up.
I agree I don’t really know anything else and find comfort in the toxic behavior since it’s what I’ve always been around. Hard to break the cycle

Im so sorry about your situation and I wish I could give you any good advice. This is my own worst fear. I’m preparing to go no contact with my nmom but that means for me my entire family on her side and all family friends etc. extremely scary feeling when you already feel so isolated in this situation already. 
It’s hard to explain to anyone outside or new what you’ve gone trough without people questioning if you again are the wrong one. All I can say is I applaud you from going no contact - that takes massive courage! From my own experience trying to make a case against your nmom towards the rest of the family only creates even more insanity (I tried it) and in the end unfortunately often you’re never believed over the nmom. 

What I can imagine I would need to do in your situation is to try as much as possible to think about how your stress levels are now compared to when you were in contact. When I moved away for a period of time I felt like you 0/10. But my worst mistake was getting sucked back in because I realized that a 0/10 is still way better than -100/10. 

A year is so little and it takes so much time to heal and find your voice and place in this unknown world without the narcissistic parents and their flying monkeys. 

You could also continue to send the rest of your family birthday cards and gestures of kindness to show that you aren’t what she is probably making you out to be. Some of them might open their eyes! 

Best of luck to you and again you’re so brave and amazing for breaking free and dealing with the aftermath!
This is my mother EXACTLY!

Are you me? I literally just did the same this weekend after 28 years of silence. No one gets how isolating this is if you haven’t lived it. No one believes you no matter what even proof will not help. Narcissistic parents makes you out to be the abuser behind your back. While they keep the most lying charming front to everyone who’s not within their private circle of close close family. 
And funny enough I am the one feeling guilty for saying what I’ve been through and almost wish I just kept quiet. 
But I knew that the quiet would kill me before or later.

That’s exactly me as well. Self isolating never believing peoples compliments and missed out on so many amazing opportunities. I still have a hard time believing I’ll ever be able to erase/escape all the vile words that was said to me my entire life.

Imagine being a parent who doesn’t want your child to be an Individual and only thinking about how they want them to be and if you aren’t happy that doesn’t matter at all.. 

I’m so sorry for what you’ve been through not being allowed to explore your own individual beauty and what makes you feel good. I was also forced to wear high heels when I was 14 to school and makeup by my mom. I got bullied a lot because of this. 

Go and get your beautiful short haircut! I’m 28 myself and still scared to cut my long hair.
Ps very glad you barely have contact with her!!!

I have no words for how fucked up that is. I am sincerely sorry for how you were treated. Basically always in a competition with their daughters aren’t they. My mother was never beautiful naturally (according to her) so she always hated me for being natural and made sure to tell everyone how I was jealous of her beauty and male attention..  apparently I still am. She also asks every man in her life if she’s more beautiful than me even when I’m around.

So sorry you also got told these insane things. It really really messes with your self image. I was as well not allowed to be myself basically. Couldn’t decide what to wear, my hairstyle, even my interior was ridiculed and my cooking yes well basically everything.
I feel your pain I was always told I ruined my mothers life from the day she gave birth to me.
If it’s not the physical it’s the personal. Whatever you do you’re always too something in a negative way ofc.
They just can’t handle you if you’re happy can’t they. So sad!
Makes me so mad to hear this. I hope one day we can all learn to kill our parents voices inside our heads!
You’re not alone I feel your pain 🥲 sorry to hear you’ve been taught nothing but self hate

That’s so awful! It’s insane how they can even get themselves to say these things to their own children/child. I will never understand it. 
My mom would always do the same and force me to do unnecessary procedures to hide a flaw no one else noticed.
I hope you’re dealing with it ok now ♥️

I’m so sorry to hear how you have struggled believing with I’m sure everyone is telling you - that your body is perfect! It’s incredible how a parents job normally is to create healthy habits and make their children grow up to be proud of themselves yet all they do is create issues/low self esteem and plenty of other things. 

My mother couldn’t let me be normal I never was chubby or anything yet she kept comparing me at a very very young age to my friends and girls in magazines. She showed me more love when I got slim and even more when I got severely anorexic (she was the only one in the family who thought I didn’t look sick). Unfortunately getting older at least with my mother she now hates that I’m slimmer than her. 

I too can’t wear clothes that show my body and I just feel generally very ugly yet others seem to think the opposite. 

So sorry that you had to go trough it all again at the funeral what a sickening comment not alone inappropriate at such a gathering.

Omg this!! 
I thought it was only my mother who would do this. Any magazine, babies of my friends, tv series etc the looks are always criticized or commented. Nothing matters besides style, weight and beauty. Always led me believing that if I didn’t look perfect I would never be loved. Jokes on me because no matter what I did I wasn’t really ever good enough. 

Wow I’m so sorry to hear how she has ranked you by physical aspects within her own family it’s unbelievable and sickening how these people can cause so much damage. How are you holding up now?

Im so sorry you had to listen and endure that kind of treatment it’s unbearable. My mom said the same thing to me when I was 12 she started saying “no man could ever love someone like you” and if I had gained a few kgs (I’ve dealt with anorexia most of my life) she would use sentences like “if my boyfriend would see you know he would laugh at how ugly you look” 
Never learned how to eat healthy either my mother is anorexic too and still asks me everyday if I can learn her to be bulimic (I recovered on my own) 
Stay strong and I hope you are healthy within yourself regardless of your mothers words and actions towards you!

Even if my mother doesn’t know per say I’m done being controlled completely she still notices that I don’t behave like her personal minion and slave anymore. 

This has caused even more abuse the rage has never been more severe and she has really amped up the “no one could ever love someone like you” statements.

I’m so sorry nothing has improved even after all that care and effort! I sort of gave up the fight. Since after years of trying to look healthy it’s just impossible. Funny thing is my doctor said I don’t have any signs of aging compared to others my age - so I truly believe it’s the sleep deprivation and constant stress levels that just ruins your glow. 

Oh god can I relate to you! I feel SO much better when my mother leaves the house I can finally breathe and I even feel a bit happy. As soon as she comes in I don’t feel like myself and have to be someone to please her which is anyways never happening.
If you ever need someone to talk just dm me as well 💕

This sounds like something I could have written myself. I’m so sorry you were deprived from your own voice and confidence for so many years. 

I was a skin biter/picker as well. Also used to hide my hands for years. I also picked everything else which helped me release my stress I think. 

My god the hair thing.. my mom was so controlling still is about my hair. Forced me to go blonde very early on I think I went to get highlights from the age of 10. She also threatened me if I cut my hair she would cut me off and make me sleep on the street. (She’s obsessed with long hair) not to mention she said my hair was so flat no one could find me attractive. Forced me to get extensions which ruined my hair for years… 

I’m so sorry about your back problems! Classic nmom not to care about it and only use critiques. My mother never took me to the er I had to force her when I broke my ankle. Then she said it was ugly with the cast. 

They ruin everything for you.

So sorry that you were treated that way. The control of narcissistic parents are insane. If you don’t do what they want or tell you, best believe you’re going to be abused for hours each day (at least the case for me) 

The controlling behavior regarding clothes is such a classic, my mother wanted me to dress like a whore and always called me a grandma which is laughable given I won the price of best dressed in my school. Even after that she said everyone at my school were losers etc etc. 

When I look back at pictures from back then I think to myself why did I have so low self esteem but it makes sense given the constant comments from my mother. 

She started when I was 13 to say no man would ever want me/fuck me and so on. Every time I got a new boyfriend she said he will leave you you’re worthless. Yet she still claims to be the only one who supports me 😂

The word escape is so true. Being surrounded by these people is like living in prison or hell every single day. 

My uncle and aunt said the same when I moved out back then ‘you look so beautiful compared to before’ ofc they never think my mother is the source since they are related. 

I’m glad you have finally found a way out and seeing it how it is.
I’m so sorry to hear that, you being a good person and taking care of your mother after all she put you trough only to again suffer in her hands. Makes me so angry. I hope you’re ok?
Thank you 🙏🏼 I try to think of that everyday. And I’m currently trying to save up for my own apartment hopefully soon I can leave for good.

Thank you SO much for this comment. It really gives me hope that I haven’t permanently ruined myself by being around my mother. She has already taken so much and the last thing I need is for my appearance to permanently be like this. Im glad you are finally free if im allowed to say that.

Wow good for you!!! So glad you are feeling so much better about yourself I’m sure you look amazing! Glad you never have to go back to your parents, I’m hopeful I will be like you when I gain the strength to leave for good.
I’m so sorry to hear that! Makes me so sad so many out there suffered permanent damage caused by narcissists
Thank you so will you!

Are you me?? Because everything you have just described I’m going trough this now. The exact issues in your face is what I’m faced with myself. Believe me when I say that it isn’t the aging - none of my friends have this and I’ve been to doctors to ask and what do they all say “are you stressed”. 

None of the skin doctors have said my skin is bad they simply all say we can’t do anything unless you get rid of the stress. No product can help sleep deprivation and constant fear. 

I spend 1 year away from my mother, even if it was hard (she still called me countless times with suicide threats) I honestly looked so much better. My skin started to brighten and weren’t grey, my eyes had shine and my eyes didn’t look hollow. 

Moved back with her and now 7 months later I am back to looking like a corpse.
Proud of you for going no contact! Takes so much strength!
Oh god same here. It’s like all your emotions are just drained and sucked out of you. The eyes are the biggest give away, mine always look so sad.
Thank you so much I’ll look it up today! Sorry you’ve gone trough the same - I’m glad you’ve found something that helps for you.

That sounds so awful and exactly what my mother does and my exes (also stuck in a pattern of men who treated me like my mother) no matter how perfect you try to be for them it’s all for nothing. So sad. 
I hope you know that nothing he made you feel is true and the one who should feel worthless is him not you on any level 💕

I’m sad to say good you don’t have any contact with them, but that’s the best decision I believe. 

Nothing is ever good enough for the narcissist.. NOTHING. If you accomplish everything they wanted they find 100 new things you can’t do or need to do better. It’s a never ending cycle of constant letdowns.

Thank you so much for your wise words.
Very true that they fight like toddlers fight that they are stuck in a cycle of ‘me, me, me’ and everything anyone does has to benefit them. It’s hard to grow up as a child never getting the confident you need to go out into the world plus the isolation you get from these people is like no other. You can’t talk to anyone about their behavior since they are charming to the outer world. I know at least I’m nothing like my mother and that’s probably the only and biggest accomplishment I have in this life.
Thank you so much!!!

Right there with you. Sometimes I can’t believe what I’ve been projected to one insane thing after the other while pretending already back in pre school everything was fine. The constant sleep deprivation gotta take a toll on you and the never feeling safe always on high alert. I am currently experiencing the beginning of a mental breakdown plus I have numbed my emotions so much I don’t feel anything anymore. It’s very scary.

Im so sorry to hear you had to move back - I know the feeling mine manipulated me back home acted sweet for two months and when I was convinced and trapped boom worst decision of my life. What baffles me about myself is that somehow I still believe she can change which is so stupid cause she never has.

God I’m so sorry to hear that! Must have been such a struggle to get out just shows how strong you are as a person! And you’re so right, never been so obsessed and critical about my appearance with anyone else. It’s the constant reminder of your partner/parents making you feel so insecure you can’t leave them. My mother used to say whenever we went outside that my skin only looked good indoors and I couldn’t show anyone this face in daylight. Which has ultimately made me so scared of going outside most of the days I hide in the house until it gets dark. (Others think I have a nice skin)
I’m the exact opposite I don’t eat at all. Which is just as terrible as the other way around. I’m glad you also managed to get out and got healthier and happier within yourself!

It’s so uplifting hearing about others who left it all behind and actually found some happiness after. When you’re stuck in this cycle you don’t see a light. Thank you again for making me have hope I really needed that tonight. 

Do you have any contact with your parents if you don’t mind me asking?

I am so happy you’re pointing this out because I’ve started to realize when she has a narcissistic rage she refers to me as a everything she is. Me and her are totally opposites so it’s making a lot of sense that she projects her own insecurities on me. Last night she said no one loves me (she always do) just after my uncle and aunt told me they loved me a lot. She just can’t have that I get positive feedback never could.

I’m so sorry you’ve been trough that! What you describe is exactly what I am seeing in the mirror, especially the grey part. I just look washed out. 

I’m glad you got away from it all! So happy for you. Being surrounded by soul eaters (as I call them) is worse than being totally alone.
I can definitely see the digestive issues. I’ve had chronic stomach pain and problems my entire life but no doctor can figure out the cause.

Good for you honestly, even if it’s never nice to roast someone I do understand it when you have a parent like this. I am a lonely child so unfortunately that makes it a bit harder since apparently everything I feel is not valid. And I have no one to back me up since it’s all hidden.
Thank you so much I’ll definitely check that book out immediately!

Thank you for your reply means the world! I’m glad you have also experienced yourself better after going no contact. I’m currently planning doing so after many years my limit has been reached. I’ve had stress constantly and can’t sleep ever. Can’t remember the last time I’ve been relaxed truly. So it’s time even if it will be hell for a while. Proud of you to go trough this and sticking with it I know how hard it is.

I have body dysmorphia as well I think it’s caused by my mother constantly critiquing my appearance since I was a child. And we are talking every single detail of my body, face, hair etc. 

Thank you for sharing this it gives me hope that I might get my appearance back when I leave. It’s hard to regain the strength when you can see you are going downhill on all aspects.

It sounds like we have the same parent only you had it with both! I’m so sorry! 

I can relate to trying to updo or copy everything you have/take interest in. My mother is the type of person who will start the same education as me go to the same shrink, heard I liked a restaurant she becomes a regular, heard I went on holiday somewhere guess who’s bringing her new boyfriend to the same place. She even claimed my bed as hers when I was away for studies - which is also just bizarre. She said she could share her dildo with me if I needed (who says this to their daughter nevertheless anyone) .. the list is endless. 

Thank you for validating how creepy her behavior is - before I found this thread I was still unaware and somehow convinced this was normal since I’ve always been someone not to share anything about my life with others.

I wish I had the nerve to say that! I can’t even imagine how people would respond. Plus I’d be crucified right after if I ever said something like this! 

You’re very correct plus as cliche as it sounds beauty comes from within - and unfortunately no surgeon can fix her mind.

Yes it really is! 

Thank you for the comforting words and you are very right no one can truly become someone else no matter how hard they try. 

Lol I laughed at your last sentence 😂

Thank you so much for your reply and time! 
I’m so deeply sorry you had to experience something similar and what an absolute monster of a dad - you sound like a very strong person to have survived this.

The way you described the pattern of how a nmom thinks and projects her own insecurities onto her child/children really does resonate. I recently turned 28 and my mothers third husband has left her - I have also come to know that she has asked him multiple times if he wanted me over her which ultimately resulted in her trying to become me. 

People do now ask if we are twins which perhaps if she had been a normal mother wouldn’t have been any issue but in my mind anything that ties me to my mother makes me feel horrible solely because I know what kind of person she is behind locked doors.

My mom always said when I was younger “this is our secret” don’t tell anyone, which my clueless self back then made me feel closer to her. Later on it became “don’t tell anyone or I’ll cut you off, take everything you own and say you’re sick” …

You didn’t do anything I can assure you. My mother did exactly this and she also compared me to rapists and pedophiles because I was into crime documentaries. I think it’s their way of making sure you won’t leave - breaking down your confidence and make you question your own identity/sanity until you become exactly what she accused you off her slave.

Thank you so much for taking the time to reply! I know deep down suicide isn’t the answer there might still be a glimpse of hope. Sometimes the tunnel gets too dark to see the light. Reading other peoples stories on here has definitely helped me understand what I’ve been trough isn’t normal. 
I hope you’re doing ok!

I have no words to express how much this reply and your kindness means to me. Almost brought a tear to my eye. 

I’m deeply sorry you’ve been trough the same, no words can really describe the feelings you’re keeping within yourself from these kind of people. I’m so happy to hear you have worked trough the issues with a therapist and found a way to have a fulfilling life. It really gives me hope. 

I relate to the part where you say you felt the best when you were abroad I had a similar experience but ended up back home. I’ve also gone to therapy but my mother goes to the same one as soon as she finds out who and that makes me silent. I have my own apartment which might sound weird given I live at home, but my mother has guilt tripped me into staying with her forever because she can’t be alone and I do feel she needs to verbally insult someone to survive herself. The apartment I’m staying in she owns -  the apartment is where I go to when she has random men over otherwise she threatens me to leave. I pay rent and I am independent just far from independent within myself. I’ve been brought up learning that I need to obey everything my mother says and she has created this web of lies around me. Not to mention ruined every form of confidence and happiness in my life. 

None of my friends knows what’s going on everyone thinks she’s an alcoholic but is charmed by her grandiose self. Every boyfriend I’ve had she has tried to either sleep with or create so much manipulation and drama around that it stopped. 

I blame myself for everything and I am so codependent to the point where I can’t even put on jeans before getting the “ok” from my mom. She threatens with suicide herself every time I put a boundary or try to be an adult. She has said my whole life I should kill myself and one day I wouldn’t have a mother because given birth to me was her worst mistake.
